summary: Advances a countdown timer that drives a session-phase transition. When the timer-active flag byte at this+45392 is non-zero, it increments the counter dword at this+45384, reads the scene-order threshold via SceneOrderReader, and when the counter reaches that threshold sets the session phase dword at this+45380 to 3; it then resets the phase counter dword at this+45388 to 1 and clears the timer-active flag to 0. Returns the SceneOrderReader threshold on the active path, otherwise returns an unspecified value.

local_names.this: owner instance holding the timer, counter, phase and session-phase state
local_names.v2: scene-order threshold read by SceneOrderReader, also the function return value

operations.description: Read the timer-active flag byte at this+45392; if zero the function returns without any state change
Increment the countdown counter dword at this+45384
Call SceneOrderReader() to obtain the scene-order threshold into v2
If the counter at this+45384 is greater than or equal to the scene-order threshold v2, set the session phase dword at this+45380 to 3
Reset the phase counter dword at this+45388 to 1 and clear the timer-active flag byte at this+45392 to 0
Return v2, which on the active path is the SceneOrderReader threshold
Reached from PitStopPhaseAdvance (0x004C15A0) as the countdown driver for the session-phase transition

unresolved: The semantic meaning of phase value 3 at this+45380 (0xB144) is unknown; the wider transition is owned by the caller PitStopPhaseAdvance.
The return value on the flag-zero path is unspecified: v2's low byte holds the (zero) flag and is only clobbered on the active path.
The exact meaning of SceneOrderReader and why the counter is compared against it is unknown.
